title: 10 Best Nicotiana Tabacum Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Nicotiana tabacum are tinctures, mucillages, teas, decoctions, and capsules, each offering unique therapeutic benefits. Tinctures provide concentrated extracts for topical or internal use, while mucillages are valued for their soothing and emollient properties. Teas and decoctions are commonly used to harness the herb’s anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects. Capsules offer a convenient form for standardized dosing. These preparations have been traditionally used to address respiratory conditions, skin irritations, and digestive ailments.
